title: Asking an AI for salary negotiation advice is a matter of concern: Controlled experimental perturbation of ChatGPT for protected and non-protected group discrimination on a contextual task with no clear ground truth answers

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbing prompt templates by varying the candidate's pronouns (he/his, she/her, they/them, or none) and analyzing the statistical differences in the starting salary offers recommended by different versions of ChatGPT.

Substituting 50 different university conditions into prompt templates—including elite private universities, state schools, online universities, diploma mills, and fictional schools—to measure their effect size on salary recommendations using Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regressions.

Permuting 19 different undergraduate majors (spanning STEM, humanities, social sciences, and a fake control major) in prompt templates to evaluate how the candidate's field of study impacts the model's recommended salary offer.

bias_targets.target: Racial and Indigenous bias (via institutional proxy)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in salary recommendations by specifically including and analyzing outcomes for graduates of Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and Tribal Colleges compared to predominantly white or elite institutions.
